results.title: Kendrick Lamar releases new album, 'GNX,' capping a year of wins : NPR
excerpts: At noon Eastern Time on Friday, Lamar dropped his sixth studio album, GNX. He did it without sharing a hint of its existence — no advance singles or videos or cryptic social media posts.

_**GNX**_ is the sixth studio album by American rapper [Kendrick Lamar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kendrick_Lamar "Kendrick Lamar") . It was [surprise-released](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surprise_album "Surprise album") on November 22, 2024, through [PGLang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PGLang "PGLang") and [Interscope Records](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interscope_Records "Interscope Records") . American rapper Kendrick Lamar has released six studio albums , one compilation album , one extended play (EP), one soundtrack album , and five mixtapes . He sold more than 17.9 million album-equivalent units worldwide as of June 2018. [[ 1 ]]() In the United States, he earned five number-one albums on the _Billboard_ 200 charts and achieved 7.5 million certified album units by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). [[ 2 ]]() Lamar began his recording career, under the stage name as K.Dot, starting with his first mixtape— _Youngest Head Nigga in Charge (Hub City Threat: Minor of the Year)_ — being released, while attending in high school.
He signed a recording contract with Top Dawg Entertainment in 2005, and his subsequent mixtapes were _Training Day_ (2007) [[ 3 ]]() , _No Sleep 'Til NYC_ (with Jay Rock ; 2007), and _C4")_ (2009). After retiring his stage name with _Kendrick Lamar")_ (2009), he scored his first entry on the _Billboard_ charts with his fifth mixtape, _Overly Dedicated_ (2010), which reached number 72 on the Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart. [[ 4 ]]()

After his debut studio album— _Section.80_ (2011)—peaked at number 113 on the _Billboard_ 200, Lamar achieved popularity with his second studio album, _Good Kid, M.A.A.D City_ (2012)—released under a joint recording contract with Aftermath Entertainment and Interscope Records —after the record has spent more weeks on the _Billboard_ 200 chart than any hip-hop studio album in history, having tallied 550 weeks by May 2023.
[[ 5 ]]() [[ 6 ]]() His third studio album, _To Pimp a Butterfly_ (2015), marked his first number-one album on the _Billboard_ 200 [[ 7 ]]() and on charts in Australia, [[ 8 ]]() Canada, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom. [[ 9 ]]()

Following his compilation album— _Untitled Unmastered_ (2016)—topping on the _Billboard_ 200 [[ 10 ]]() , his fourth studio album, _Damn")_ (2017), was the _Billboard_ year-end number-one album of 2017 [[ 11 ]]() and the seventh-best-selling album worldwide of the year. [[ 12 ]]() He curated and executive-produced a soundtrack album, _Black Panther: The Album")_ (2018), which broke the record for the most streams in a single week for a soundtrack album. [[ 13 ]]() His fifth studio album, _Mr. Morale & the Big Steppers_ (2022), marked the conclusion of his tenure with TDE and Aftermath. The album became a chart-topper record in over ten countries and was the first hip hop album of 2022 to accumulate over one billion streams on Spotify .
[[ 14 ]]() He surprise-released his sixth studio album, _GNX")_ (2024), at the tail-end of his-then ongoing feud with Canadian rapper Drake") . The album also produced two additional number one hits with " Squabble Up " and " Luther") "—the latter of which spent 13 consecutive weeks at number one—on the _Billboard_ Hot 100.
